verdict.rationale: Kit's API docs confirm drafting/scheduling a broadcast (send/schedule) with audience targeting by segment or tag (kit-docs-1, kit-docs-2), covering the core compose-audience-send/schedule loop, and this is corroborated by the product's broader marketing platform positioning (kit-docs-14, kit-docs-15). missing for 10: independent hands-on user account of composing and sending a real campaign via the UI, and detail on scheduling UI/preview features beyond the API reference.
